ValidationRule.description: Requires Service Address, Budget Validated, Business Problem Evidenced, Customer Outcome Predefined, Decision Process Defined, and Impact / Consequences Identified to be populated leaving Stage 1, and to remain populated through every later stage and once
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validation),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Standard_Opportunity", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Framework_Parent_Opportunity" ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, "New Deal"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Cross-Sell/Upsell") ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "High Touch"), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "Medium Touch"), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "Low Touch"), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "No Touch") ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "RIM"), ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "Digital"), ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "ALM") ),
OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Qualification"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Solutioning") ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Solutioning"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Negotiation") ), IF( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Framework_Parent_Opportunity", AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Negotiation"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booked") ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Negotiation"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booking Verification") ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Booking Verification"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booked") ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Booked"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Setup") ), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed") ),
OR( ISBLANK(Service_Address__Street__s), ISBLANK(Service_Address__City__s), ISBLANK(TEXT(Service_Address__StateCode__s)), ISBLANK(Service_Address__PostalCode__s), ISBLANK(TEXT(Service_Address__CountryCode__s)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Budget_Validated__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Business_Problem_Evidenced__c)), ISBLANK(Customer_Outcome_Predefined__c), NOT(Decision_Process_Defined__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Impact_Consequences_Identified__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please complete Service Address, Budget Validated, Business Problem Evidenced, Customer Outcome Predefined, Decision Process Defined, and Impact / Consequences Identified before leaving Stage 1. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
